verdict.rationale: Better Auth's evidence covers auth primitives, a hosted docs MCP server for external AI clients, and an MCP/agent-delegation plugin that lets apps authorize AI agents. None of this is a built-in AI assistant inside Better Auth that users can delegate tasks to. Serving tools to external agents and authorizing agent access are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
